summary: Visual regression of CategoryGrid fixes validated on web preview (390x844). All 13 category tiles now share IDENTICAL bounding boxes (106x104 px, diff=0) both in onboarding step 1 and in the (tabs)/explore screen, including tiles with two-line names ('Economia & Denaro', 'Arte & Design', 'Geografia & Viaggi', 'Corpo umano'). No 'chevron-forward' glyph is rendered inside any category tile (probed innerHTML + private-use unicode range). Icon and text elements are horizontally centered (text center delta from tile center = 0 px for every tile). Selecting a tile spawns a small check badge at top-right (16x16 at top:7, right:7, Ionicons checkmark glyph U+f21d) with an accent glow; unselected tiles have no such badge. Toggle works both ways: chip-psicologia tap→badge appears, second tap→badge cleared. 'chip-all' vs specific-chip exclusivity works. CTA 'onboarding-continue' is aria-disabled=true initially and enabled after >=1 selection. Selecting scienza+arte and tapping continue fired POST /api/user/interests and POST /api/user/content-modes and navigated to /discover; downstream GET /api/user/{id}, /api/discover-next also fired. In Explore, tapping chip-natura fired POST /api/user/interests (200) and 'interests-count' updated 2→3. Light theme (pause.theme.mode='light') keeps tiles readable — name color rgb(11,14,23) and count rgb(91,98,117) on the light frosted surface (no white-on-white). Zero console errors captured across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: category-grid.tsx: TILE_H=104 with paddingTop 10 / paddingBottom 9 and tileTexts marginTop 5 + gap 1 leaves enough room for a 2-line 12.5/15 name plus a 10.5/13 count without overflow — verified in DOM (no ellipsis triggered for the longest label 'Geografia & Viaggi').

tileBadge (position:absolute, top:7, right:7) sits above the sheen/border layers; matches the 16x16 GlassCheck (size=16). Absolute positioning works because GlassPressable inner Pressable has overflow:hidden and the badge is the last child.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual bug fixes for CategoryGrid confirmed on web. Note: RN-Web Pressable does not surface aria-checked=true after selection (attribute is null both before and after); rely on the badge DOM probe (private-use glyph U+f21d and absolute-positioned 16x16 element at top:7,right:7) or the POST /api/user/interests network call to verify selection state instead of aria-checked.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this was a visual polish iteration, not a bug hunt. Fix approach used a fixed TILE_H=104 on the inner contentStyle plus centered flex layout for the icon/name/count column, and moved the selected indicator from an in-flow chevron/check to an absolutely-positioned 16px GlassCheck badge (top:7,right:7). This decouples tile height from label length, guaranteeing 3-column visual rhythm.
